text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding anything that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might buy insurance or train your staff. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a risk becomes real. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and ready for challenges.
